benchmark_note: Benchmark: the margin each precinct would show if the race were tied citywide, from its June Wiener-vs-Chan margins by vote type (early mail, Election Day, late mail) relative to the citywide June margin of that type, weighted by the precinct's counted November votes of each type.
neighborhood_note: Precincts are assigned to the SF Find neighborhood containing most of their area; boundaries are approximate.
lambda_note: Estimated from the within-precinct contrast of counted vote types
notes: The Department of Elections posts precinct results in batches: about hourly on election night, then once a day at about 4 pm PT. Mail ballots postmarked by Election Day can arrive and be counted for a week or more, so the count moves for days.
